title: Flask/Vue book discovery decomposition
task_summary: Partition a large full-stack release into a few end-to-end product capabilities rather than technical phases.

approved_outcomes.outcome: Read-status filtering works end to end.
Title and author search works end to end and composes with filtering.
Bounded pagination and total count compose with filter and search.
Discovery state is shareable in the URL and restores across reload and browser navigation.
Controls, active state, results, and empty states remain clear and accessible.
CRUD refreshes retain the current discovery view.
Existing CRUD and unparameterized API behavior remain compatible.

coherent_deliverables.title: Deliver read-status filtering end to end
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: Users gain a complete usable filter through the real client/server path.

coherent_deliverables.title: Add title and author search end to end
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: Search is independently useful and composes with the established filter query conventions.

coherent_deliverables.title: Add bounded pagination end to end
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: Pagination is a complete independently reviewable scale capability.

coherent_deliverables.title: Add shareable URL state and browser restoration
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: URL persistence is a separately useful workflow enhancement over the working controls.

acceptable_alternatives: Read filtering and search may be combined if both remain independently traceable and the slice stays reviewable.
URL parsing may be separate only when it is an independently maintained reusable contract.
fragmentation_examples: Flask query parsing as a separate task.
Database filtering as a separate task.
Frontend API client as a separate task.
Vue state and controls as separate tasks.
Component tests, integration tests, documentation, and final review as horizontal tasks.
overpacking_examples: One child containing all discovery capabilities and every crossing hides independently useful releases.
important_crossings: Each product capability crosses Vue state/rendering, production transport, Flask HTTP routing, and data selection.
open_questions: Exact query encoding and URL parameter names remain material contract decisions.

handoff.retain_plan: Preserve the reviewed vertical delivery rationale and dependency graph.
handoff.omit_plan: Preserve approved outcomes, project facts, cross-layer constraints, and public questions without the four-slice implementation direction.
handoff.fresh_agent_plan: A fresh agent reconstructs a small vertical partition and does not expand layers or test types into separate phases.

required_content.content: The discovery state contract between client and server: what read-status filtering, title/author search, bounded pagination, and total count are exchanged.
The composability rules and bounds: how search composes with filtering and pagination, and where the bounds are.
The URL shareability design: which discovery state encodes in the URL and how it restores across reload and browser navigation.
How CRUD refreshes retain the current discovery view instead of resetting it.
How existing CRUD and unparameterized API behavior remain compatible.
The adoption sequence across the Vue state/rendering, production transport, Flask routing, and data selection crossings — with the state contract settled before the surfaces that consume it.
